paragraphs: The 550e xDrive is part of the G60-generation 5 Series range, introduced in 2023. It uses the B58 — a 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine — paired with an electric motor in a plug-in hybrid (PHEV) configuration, making it a distinct offering from both the purely combustion-powered 540i and the fully electric i5 models. The 550e is the higher-output I6-based PHEV in the range (distinct from the 530e's I4 setup and the M5's S68 V8 PHEV). The B58 is a well-regarded engine with no widely-reported defect pattern, though like all high-performance engines it benefits from regular maintenance and professional rebuilds when needed.
about.boldParagraph: The 550e xDrive is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
